## Checklist

- [ ] `make check-all` and `make type-check-strict` pass. `check-all` runs `make format` first, so commit any files it rewrites.
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `make test-unit` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for any user-visible change.
- [ ] Docs, docstrings, examples or bundled skills are updated where behavior changed.
